scope: 47 historical items; source decade groupings retained. Selected contributors are supported by the cited works, not exhaustive team rosters or sole-invention claims.
research_method: Compared all entries with the canonical 384-record bibliography; checked primary papers, publication-time affiliations, SRI project/person pages, author histories and manuals. Repeated broad entries use era-specific references. Unresolved gaps remain visible. No bibliography entries were added.

items.label: HybridSAL
items.description: Modeling and verification of hybrid systems through qualitative hybrid abstraction and relational abstraction. HybridSAL extends SAL with continuous dynamics and produces discrete abstractions for analysis with SAL model checkers.
items.note: The directly matching publication is from 2011. The source figure’s 2000s grouping is preserved, not asserted as this paper’s date. User replaced the entry with HybridSAL, retaining its decade. Official framework documentation connects its earlier qualitative abstractor with the later relational extension; the 2008 hybrid abstraction paper supplies decade-specific context.
items.gap: The precise 2000s milestone intended by the original grouping is not established.
items.collaborators: Sriram Sankaranarayanan (University of Colorado), coauthor of the 2011 relational-abstraction paper.
items.public_note: Qualitative abstraction builds finite-state models. Relational abstraction summarizes continuous evolution as relations between states; the 2011 paper and 2012 tool paper describe this extension.
